verdict.rationale: Independent community reports say Docusaurus is open source and MIT licensed, and users describe contributing to its codebase, which means the source is readable under an open license. All of this comes from community comments rather than first-party docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the license and the public source repository location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: keeping it MIT licensed so the community can fork it if Facebook ever decides to stop maintaining it
it's open source! I've been able to contribute to it myself.
